description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of various language models across three categories: Understanding, Reasoning, and Trustworthiness. The Understanding category is represented on the left bar chart, with the horizontal axis indicating the percentage scale from 0% to 100%. The bars are arranged in descending order of performance, with the highest average performance at 98.0% and the lowest at 2.4%. The Reasoning category is depicted on the middle bar chart, also with a horizontal axis ranging from 0% to 100%, and the bars are similarly ordered from highest to lowest average performance, with the highest at 66.5% and the lowest at 7.2%. The Trustworthiness category is shown on the right bar chart, with the horizontal axis also ranging from 0% to 100%, and the bars are ordered from highest to lowest average performance, with the highest at 88.8% and the lowest at 0.0%. Each bar is labeled with the name of the language model and its corresponding average performance percentage. The bars are colored in blue, and the chart does not include any additional visual emphasis such as shading or bolding.
